title: College Football
description:
Wisconsin at Iowa
The No. 25 Wisconsin Badgers and the Iowa Hawkeyes meet in a Big Ten rivalry matchup at Kinnick Stadium. Quarterback Colton Joseph leads Wisconsin with 11 touchdowns, while Iowa aims for momentum behind quarterback Hank Brown's six touchdowns.

title: College Football
description:
Arizona State at BYU
The Arizona State Devils (4-3) take on the No. 8 BYU Cougars (6-1) at LaVell Edwards Stadium. Arizona State beat Kansas State 28-17 behind Cardae Mack, while BYU fell to UCF 39-31 and relies on quarterback Bear Bachmeier who has 11 TDs this season.

title: College Football
description:
Oklahoma State at Iowa State
The Iowa State Cyclones meet the No. 24 Oklahoma State Cowboys in a Big 12 Conference game at Jack Trice Stadium. Drew Mestemaker leads Oklahoma State with 20 touchdowns, while Iowa State aims to break a two-game skid behind Jaylen Raynor.
